dining.name: Fun Town Market Fresh
dining.summary: The park's main indoor cafeteria — real options for picky kids and allergy families, in air conditioning.
description: Fun Town Market Fresh is the park's principal quick-service: a market-format cafeteria with carved meats, pizzas, salads and a genuinely broad kids' range. The allergy handling is the standout — the park's family audience makes it a core competency rather than an afterthought.
Indoor seating in the Carlsbad marine layer is comfortable year-round. It fills at noon and turns over by one.
tips: Allergy families: ask for the allergen guide at the register — the handling here is the park's strength.
Eat at 11:30; the noon wave is the park's biggest queue.
dining.verdict: The best in-park family cafeteria standard: broad, honest and allergy-competent. It is a cafeteria and a good one.

dining.name: Granny's Apple Fries
dining.summary: The park's signature snack — apple chunks in a crispy shell, dusted with cinnamon sugar and dipped in vanilla cream.
description: Granny's Apple Fries are Legoland California's food landmark: warm apple pieces in a fried pastry shell, cinnamon sugar, and a vanilla cream dipping sauce. The queue is perennial and the snack deserves it — it is the one item at the park that families who visit annually reference by name.
The cart sits in Castle Hill near the fried treat stand's long-standing spot; the smell does the marketing.
tips: One order is a snack for two kids or a dessert for one adult.
Eat them immediately — the crisp is the whole point and it fades fast.
dining.verdict: The best snack at the park and one of the better ones in the region. An annual-visit ritual for a generation of SoCal families.
